title: Trainer async bookkeeping callback fires after future is FINISHED — state_dict snapshot can capture pre-callback state
trigger_conditions: Trainer launches a bookkeeping op (e.g., async checkpoint save) that has a completion cb
root_cause: _run_bookkeeping_op attached cb via future.add_done_callback. add_done_callback runs after the future is marked FINISHED, so _join_bookkeeping_ops returned before cb ran, and a state_dict() capture immediately after could observe stale callback state (e.g., un-rotated checkpoint indexes).
invariant: All bookkeeping callbacks for a future must complete before that future transitions to FINISHED so _join_bookkeeping_ops waits on them too.
diff_summary: Invoke cb inside wrapped_op before returning, instead of via future.add_done_callback, so the cb completion is part of the future result.
